definitions.gloss: urban area; built-up area; city center; downtown area
definitions.explanation: An area within a city or town where buildings, shops, and residences are densely concentrated. Contrasts with residential suburbs, industrial zones, or rural areas.

examples.japanese: {市街地|しがいち}は{交通量|こうつうりょう}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: There is heavy traffic in the urban area.

examples.japanese: {市街地|しがいち}から{少|すこ}し{離|はな}れた{場所|ばしょ}に{住|す}んでいる。
examples.english: I live a little away from the city center.

examples.japanese: {市街地|しがいち}の{再開発|さいかいはつ}によって、{古|ふる}い{商店街|しょうてんがい}が{姿|すがた}を{消|け}しつつある。
examples.english: Due to urban redevelopment, old shopping streets are gradually disappearing.

notes:
USAGE:
Common in urban planning, real estate, and news contexts. Also used in speed limit signs: {市街地|しがいち}では{時速|じそく}40km.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {市街地|しがいち}{中心部|ちゅうしんぶ} (city center)
- {市街地|しがいち}の{開発|かいはつ} (urban development)
- {市街地|しがいち}{走行|そうこう} (driving in urban areas)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {繁華街|はんかがい}: entertainment district — specifically the lively shopping and entertainment area
- {都心|としん}: city center — the very center or core of a large city
- {郊外|こうがい}: suburbs — the areas surrounding the urban center
